data.title: Notification of cessation of securities - ZNC

situations.headline: Forrestania's off-market scrip bid for Zenith extended again amid Takeovers Panel dispute; implied offer value now above market

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Forrestania's off-market scrip bid for Zenith extended again amid Takeovers Panel dispute; implied offer value now above market (interest 6, risk 4)

thesis.text: Zenith is the target of a contested off-market takeover by Forrestania, now backed by a strengthened balance sheet post-Edna May acquisition; the scrip offer's implied value has moved to a slight premium over Zenith's market price, but repeated extensions and a Takeovers Panel unacceptable-circumstances declaration introduce execution and timing risk; the ASX cessation notice suggests the offer may have reached compulsory acquisition or delisting stage, warranting continued monitoring of final Panel orders and settlement mechanics.
